title: 大型语言模型表现出一致的风险态度
summary: 该研究通过跨领域框架（空间导航、临床分诊、财务分配）测试了六个代表性LLM和100名人类参与者，发现大多数LLM在任务内和跨任务中表现出稳定且一致的风险态度，且其风险态度分布比人类基线更受限。这揭示了风险态度是LLM行为中一个稳定且此前未被表征的维度。
summary_en: This study tests six representative LLMs and 100 human participants across spatial navigation, clinical triage, and financial allocation tasks using a cross-domain framework. It finds that most LLMs exhibit stable and consistent risk attitudes within and across tasks, with a more restricted distribution than the human baseline, revealing risk attitude as a stable, previously uncharacterized dimension of LLM behavior.
